summary: Live regression completed: backend assessment/image validation passed, browser result/history/export flows passed, but mobile results overflow horizontally.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px viewport document scrollWidth is 488px (main/results width expands to 420px), producing horizontal overflow and content outside the viewport.

action_items: Constrain the results/main content width at mobile (including long recommendation text) so document scrollWidth remains 390px or less; retest report controls and result photo.
critical_code_review_comments: The mobile media rules do not prevent a child/results canvas from expanding beyond the available 322px content area; add min-width:0 and overflow-safe wrapping/constraining to the relevant result containers.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_live_beam_review, TEST_JPEG, TEST_PNG, TEST_WEBP, and TEST_browser_beam assessment records during live tests; records remain in history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest 3/3 passed. Browser verified real non-uniform JPEG upload, result photo rendering, three recommendations, IS-code content, history reopen, PDF/DOCX/XLSX signatures, and no page error elements. Only mobile horizontal overflow remains. One initial browser assertion was test-only case sensitivity and was rerun successfully.
rca of the issue: At 390px, html/body scrollWidth measured 488px while clientWidth was 390px; .main-content measured 420px and .results measured 420px against a 322px available content width beside the 68px sidebar. The responsive rules stack content but do not constrain the expanding result canvas/child width. Historical backend logs also contain intermittent AI invalid-JSON/500/502 events, but all current regression requests passed.
